scope.goal: 为宋艾欣建立以黑色为主体、融合 YSL 视觉气质与 Youdoo 交互语法的 AI 产品经理个人网站方向。
scope.deliverable: 双参考站分析、融合原则、视觉系统、布局语法、交互清单、响应式边界和素材计划。
not_in_scope: 下载或复制参考站素材

brief_interpretation.latest_user_direction: 主体颜色改为黑色；以 Youdoo 的视觉、交互和布局为基础，融合更贴近个人风格的 YSL 视觉气质。
brief_interpretation.attachment_note: 附件提示词包含 Youdoo 高精度复刻要求和黑色主标题描述，但未检索到独立的 YSL 设计章节；YSL 方向以本轮用户补充为准。
brief_interpretation.design_statement: YSL 提供视觉气质，Youdoo 提供交互骨架，个人经历与证据提供全部内容语义。

大面积高圆角消费电子卡片

reference_sites.name: Saint Laurent

source_interpretation.asset_policy: 不复制或发布参考站 Logo、字体文件、商品图、模特图、视频和营销文案；只研究比例、节奏和交互语法。

patterns_observed: 按钮附近的圆点跟随和缩放反馈

hero.media: full-bleed image or muted video with object-fit cover

typography.style: uppercase, compact line-height, generous spatial separation

desktop_1440x900.scene_behavior: wheel input changes full-viewport image/video scenes while the document scroll position remains visually fixed
desktop_1440x900.hover: pointer cursor with restrained linear color transition

mobile.hero: full-screen portrait media with center-bottom label and CTA
mobile.header: centered brand mark with compact menu/search controls
mobile.layout: single media column with reduced navigation density

brand_direction.positioning: 把复杂 AI 能力，做成有边界、可验证、可交付的产品闭环。
personalization: 用个人姓名与自有字标替换品牌 Logo
用真实项目影像与证据替换商品广告
用产品判断和贡献边界替换营销卖点
用社区、研学和长期兴趣补全人格
用联系合作替换购买行为

typography.display_stack: Cormorant Garamond, Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, serif
typography.ui_stack: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans SC, PingFang SC, sans-serif

surface.shadow: avoid decorative drop shadows; separate planes with luminance and overlays

motion.reduced_motion: disable smooth scrolling, magnetic cursor, pinning, parallax, auto-advance and mask-heavy transitions

background_system.use: 身份首屏、旗舰案例、联系收束
background_system.media: black-and-white or low-saturation full-bleed portrait, project film or interface montage

background_system.use: 方法、证据、长文和双列画廊
background_system.media: sharp editorial crops, numbered artifacts and generous whitespace

background_system.use: 局部编号、进度、鼠标状态和少量关键判断
background_system.media: accent only; do not become a continuous full-page theme

navigation.expanded_state: 80px transparent full-width layer over the opening media
navigation.compact_state: 56px black capsule after leaving the hero
navigation.mobile_pattern: centered name mark plus menu and compact action; opens a full-screen black navigation sheet

page_map.name: 首页
page_map.purpose: 以一次沉浸体验建立人物气质，并让访问者迅速进入三个旗舰案例。
page_map.reference_pattern: YSL 全屏媒体气质 + Youdoo 视口级滚动场景

page_map.name: 项目
page_map.purpose: 在视觉浏览与快速筛选之间取得平衡，进入可验证的项目详情。
page_map.reference_pattern: Youdoo 径向/横向浏览 + YSL 编辑画廊

page_map.name: 案例详情
page_map.purpose: 呈现问题、角色、关键判断、过程、证据、结果与贡献边界。

page_map.name: 随笔

page_map.reference_pattern: 克制的编辑索引与大幅图像

page_map.name: 关于
page_map.purpose: 用长文、肖像、时间线与长期兴趣补全人格，而不是重复简历。

high_level_site_flow.purpose: 建立姓名、岗位、核心表达与第一眼个人气质。
high_level_site_flow.layout: 100svh 全幅黑色媒体，小号信息贴近底部，大标题只完成一次进入式揭示。
high_level_site_flow.source_blend: YSL full-screen campaign scene + Youdoo 100vh opening rhythm

high_level_site_flow.purpose: 用三个 S 级案例证明产品判断、AI 构建和业务交付。
high_level_site_flow.layout: 桌面为一组视口级固定叙事；移动端为自然纵向案例。
high_level_site_flow.source_blend: Youdoo pinned storytelling + YSL cinematic media transitions

high_level_site_flow.purpose: 让招聘者退出沉浸模式后快速浏览和跳转。
high_level_site_flow.layout: 环形或横向可探索视图与普通列表并存。
high_level_site_flow.source_blend: Youdoo radial wheel/horizontal rail + YSL minimal captions

high_level_site_flow.purpose: 用清晰的研究产物、证据状态和贡献边界建立可信度。
high_level_site_flow.layout: 米白背景、双列竖幅图、细线与 800px 阅读栏。
high_level_site_flow.source_blend: YSL two-column editorial gallery + personal evidence system

high_level_site_flow.purpose: 通过兴趣、社区与联系信息完成人格收束。
high_level_site_flow.layout: 回到黑色，以人物影像、短句和极简联系入口结束。
high_level_site_flow.source_blend: YSL restrained ending + Youdoo direct action clarity

interaction_inventory.behavior: 12px ivory dot plus 36px hairline ring with slight interpolated lag
interaction_inventory.reduced_motion: use native cursor and static hover

interaction_inventory.behavior: low-damping smooth scroll that preserves direction and settles quickly
wheel progress switches media, title, metadata and exposure inside one flagship sequence
media remains pinned while short problem, decision and result statements advance
covers travel on a large radius; active project grows and exposes its index
interaction_inventory.touch_fallback: horizontal snap rail plus list view

interaction_inventory.behavior: drag or wheel through prototypes, artifacts and personal imagery
navigation labels flip vertically in about 480ms
80px transparent full-width header contracts into a 56px black floating capsule
paired portrait media with small captions and generous negative space
image scales 1.015–1.03, overlay lightens and title rises slightly
black curtain or title mask opens a case in 450–650ms
muted looping video with visible play/pause, sound status and poster

flagship_presentation.fairland-competitor-agent: black-and-white evidence dashboard, graph lines and exception states
flagship_presentation.fairland-igarden: cinematic product ecosystem media with controlled motion and spatial layers
flagship_presentation.baike-ai-education: ivory editorial scene with oxblood annotations and delivery evidence

supporting_content: community, mental-health, music, yoga and calligraphy
experience_mapping.evidence_rule: Every public result must distinguish verified fact, team result, personal contribution, solution-stage claim and pending evidence.

responsive_strategy.behavior: 1180px content grid, 100svh scenes, cursor follow, pinned cases and two-column editorial gallery
32–48px gutters, shorter pinned distance, retain two-column gallery and horizontal rail
remove strong radial perspective, simplify header, convert cases to two-column or vertical layout
16px gutters, single-column natural flow, no custom cursor, no wheel capture, full-screen navigation

accessibility_and_performance.pointer: custom cursor only when pointer:fine; preserve native cursor for forms and reading contexts
accessibility_and_performance.keyboard: all links, carousels, menus and media controls are keyboard reachable with visible focus
accessibility_and_performance.motion: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling, magnetism, pinning, parallax, auto-advance and mask-heavy transitions
accessibility_and_performance.scroll: do not use site-wide scroll snap or make mouse interaction the only path to content
accessibility_and_performance.video: autoplay video is muted, can be paused and has a poster; essential information is also text
accessibility_and_performance.contrast: ivory text on black and black text on ivory are the default readable pairs
accessibility_and_performance.performance_budget: poster-first media, responsive image sources, lazy-load content below the first viewport, reserve dimensions to prevent layout shift
